prompts.name: sky
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for layered parallax mission briefing of TANKZ, a stylized low-poly desert armored combat game. Art-directed cinematic matte painting with angular rock planes, dusty ochre, desaturated olive, charcoal and pale amber dusk rim lighting; sophisticated restrained military concept art, not cartoon. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, interface or frame. Wide 16:9 opaque background plate. Vast dusty desert evening sky, pale amber glow low on the right horizon, muted blue-gray upper sky, very distant hazy sandstone ridges only along the lowest quarter. Empty atmospheric negative space in left half. No vehicles, buildings, foreground objects.
